principles: Behavior preservation beats line-count reduction for lifecycle commands.
Move only lifecycle shell code; do not move business handlers, gates, or policy registries.
Keep cli-engine.ts compatibility exports until all consumers migrate.
Every moved process fact must remain mechanically covered by tests or contract checks.
drivers: story_advance INIT_CHECK and DONE paths can corrupt worktree/main state if ordering changes.
recover_evidence has special stdout-before-error semantics that generic dispatch does not cover.
This story builds on B-a776, so newly extracted parser/help/alias/root/ownership modules should remain stable inputs rather than active refactor targets.

options.name: A: Thin lifecycle helper modules with cli-engine retaining top-level runCli orchestration
pros: Minimizes behavior drift by keeping parse/validate/run wrapper ordering in one place.
Allows focused extraction of metadata reconcile and special dispatch branches.
Compatibility exports stay simple and existing smokes can compare behavior.
cons: cli-engine.ts remains a sizeable orchestrator after this round.
Lifecycle-dispatch helpers need dependency injection parameters, which is a little verbose.

options.name: B: Move the entire runCli body into cli/run-cli.ts
pros: Largest immediate line-count reduction in cli-engine.ts.
Creates a clean dedicated CLI runtime module.
cons: High blast radius: hook ordering, logging fallback, phase gate, owner lease, and JSON decoration all move at once.
Harder to tell whether regressions came from lifecycle extraction or generic command dispatch movement.

options.name: C: Only extract commitInitCheckMetadataAndMergeMain and leave dispatch branches in cli-engine.ts
pros: Safest first step for metadata reconcile behavior.
cons: Does not satisfy the story goal of extracting lifecycle dispatch and runCli orchestration helpers.
Leaves story_create, INIT_CHECK, and recover_evidence special cases tangled in cli-engine.ts.

chosen: A: Thin lifecycle helper modules with cli-engine retaining top-level runCli orchestration
rationale: Option A gives meaningful lifecycle modularization while preserving the sensitive generic runCli order in cli-engine.ts, which is the safest path for a high-risk lifecycle refactor.

preMortem.scenario: INIT_CHECK phase metadata is written without a matching worktree bootstrap.
preMortem.trigger: The extracted INIT_CHECK helper accidentally calls story_advance before dev_start or skips the full guard pre-check.
preMortem.consequence: A story can get stuck in partial INIT_CHECK or later fail DONE merge because main/worktree metadata diverges.
preMortem.mitigation: Keep the existing bootstrap-first order in one helper and run worktree-authority, init-check-required-agents, nested-worktree bootstrap, and init-check reconcile smokes.

preMortem.scenario: Metadata reconcile silently commits or resolves files outside the story metadata path.
preMortem.trigger: Moving commitInitCheckMetadataAndMergeMain loses bounded staging or out-of-bounds conflict checks.
preMortem.consequence: Main or story worktree state can be overwritten during INIT_CHECK recovery.
preMortem.mitigation: Keep stageBoundedMetadataPath/isPathUnderAny checks intact and run init-check-reconcile-conflict plus main-write-lock coverage.

preMortem.scenario: recover_evidence returns a generic handler error instead of structured stdout then non-zero stderr.
preMortem.trigger: Special recover_evidence dispatch is folded into generic handler dispatch too early.
preMortem.consequence: Operators lose the diagnostic JSON needed to repair stale evidence and scripts observe the wrong exit contract.
preMortem.mitigation: Extract a dedicated recover evidence dispatch helper and run verification-freshness smoke plus a focused lifecycle-dispatch smoke.

preMortem.scenario: Owner/reviewer/hook ordering regresses after dispatch extraction.
preMortem.trigger: Lifecycle helper bypasses the shared run wrapper or runs hooks before reviewer read-only and owner lease gates.
preMortem.consequence: Blocked commands could mutate leases, write hooks, or escape reviewer read-only policy.
preMortem.mitigation: Keep all lifecycle special branches invoked through the existing run wrapper and run command-ownership-contract, process-fact contract, and command-catalog smoke.
